targets.name: Patterned tin frog
targets.concealment: The small low green body shares the same painted curls and metal hues as crowded gear trays, with thin legs mixed among small tools.

targets.name: Tin grasshopper
targets.concealment: Its narrow green legs are camouflaged among wire-like tool pieces; the painted body repeats nearby geometric patterns.

targets.name: Patterned tin turtle
targets.concealment: Its multicolored shell blends with similarly patterned tins and circular pieces; the tiny legs disappear into surrounding metal clutter.

targets.name: Tin rabbit by the window
targets.concealment: The little tan painted rabbit is tucked into the patterned window ledge among warm leaves and wood grain.

targets.name: Blue-and-gold tin fish
targets.concealment: The fish lies sideways along a shelf edge among painted metal boxes, so its bands and fine fins repeat the nearby decorative pattern.

targets.name: Train illustration on a lid
targets.concealment: The flat miniature train is embedded in the elaborate painted border of an angled tin lid.

targets.name: Ferris wheel illustration
targets.concealment: The wheel is a flat painted image on a tilted metal panel, sharing the color and fine line rhythm of its surrounding ornament.

targets.name: Long double-ended brass key
targets.concealment: The narrow brass piece follows the wood grain among similarly colored rings and plates; its different-sized end openings distinguish it.

targets.name: Slim steel dividers
targets.concealment: The two narrow legs are almost the same tone as nearby metal offcuts and lie among similarly angled tool pieces.

targets.name: Open clock-spring tin
targets.concealment: Coiled gray metal merges into the many circular gear outlines and warm bronze container rims on the worktable.

targets.name: Three-lobed winding key
targets.concealment: A small matte-gold key is integrated into a scatter of similarly colored plates, washers and screw heads; its three different openings distinguish it.

targets.name: Red enamel mug
targets.concealment: The bright red mug is openly displayed at the back of the table.

targets.name: Yellow toy truck
targets.concealment: The large yellow vehicle stands clearly in the middle-right of the table.

targets.name: Blue striped cloth
targets.concealment: The broad blue fabric is spread clearly across the front worktable.

targets.name: Green toolbox
targets.concealment: The large green box is fully exposed at the front-right edge.

review.notes: All15 actual targets checked in source-context overlays. The wrongly interpreted chest motif was rejected; complete tin rabbit ears, train and Ferris wheel prints were retraced from enlarged coordinate grids. Eleven authored challenging placements and four easy anchors; phone playtesting pending. Visible handle/open key-bow openings checked in enlarged affine ROIs and excluded from reveal/preview masks. Glass lenses remain part of their magnifier targets.
